Guide: [ComfyUI-RMBG](https://github.com/1038lab/ComfyUI-RMBG)

## Model Links

- [Hugging Face: 1038lab/MultiMatte](https://huggingface.co/1038lab/MultiMatte)

**RMBG / MultiMatte** *(auto-downloads on first run, or download manually — pick one)*

- [MultiMatte-bf16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/1038lab/MultiMatte/resolve/main/MultiMatte-bf16.safetensors) *(1.57 GB, default)*
- [MultiMatte-fp8.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/1038lab/MultiMatte/resolve/main/MultiMatte-fp8.safetensors) *(0.84 GB, low VRAM)*
- [MultiMatte.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/1038lab/MultiMatte/resolve/main/MultiMatte.safetensors) *(3.13 GB, full FP32)*

## Model Storage Location

```
📂 ComfyUI/
├── 📂 models/
│   └── 📂 RMBG/
│       └── 📂 MultiMatte/
│           └── MultiMatte-bf16.safetensors   # or fp8 / MultiMatte.safetensors
```

## Prompt & Node Settings

- **Text-guided or Auto**: Enter an English description in **`prompt`** (e.g., `flowing hair`, `glass bottle`, `woman in red`, `wedding veil`) to extract a specific target, or leave **`prompt`** empty to automatically matte the main foreground subject.
- **Soft Hair-Level Edges**: Enable **`refine_foreground`** to prevent dark or colored fringes on fine hairs and semi-transparent edges; enable **`unload_model`** to free VRAM immediately after execution.

## Report Issue

Note: Please update ComfyUI ([guide](https://docs.comfy.org/installation/update_comfyui)) and **ComfyUI-RMBG** to the latest version first.

- Node / Workflow issues: [ComfyUI-RMBG/issues](https://github.com/1038lab/ComfyUI-RMBG/issues)

## MultiMatte capabilities and limits

Sources: [1038lab/MultiMatte](https://huggingface.co/1038lab/MultiMatte) and `AILab_MultiMatte` node implementation.

### Resolution

| Item | Behavior |
|------|----------|
| Internal processing size | **Fixed `1008×1008`** (SAM 3 vision backbone) |
| Aspect ratio | Arbitrary input supported |
| Output resolution | Bilinearly interpolated back to **original input image size** |

### Strengths

- **Promptable or One-Click Auto**: Type an English prompt (e.g., `flowing hair`, `glass bottle`, `woman in red`, `wedding veil`) to isolate a specific target, or leave `prompt` empty to automatically matte the main foreground subject.
- **Hair-Level Continuous Alpha**: Produces smooth, soft alpha mattes instead of jagged SAM binary masks.
- **Zero Extra Dependencies**: Runs out of the box using bundled SAM 3 code with no external package installs or upgrades.
- **Built-In Edge Cleanup**: `refine_foreground` is enabled by default (`True`) to remove dark or colored background bleed along semi-transparent edges.

### Limits / notes

- **English Prompts**: `prompt` should be written in English for best grounding accuracy.
- **Fine Details on Very High-Res Images**: Because inference runs at `1008×1008`, ultra-thin details in 4K+ images may soften slightly; crop first when matting tiny distant objects.
- **Auto-Download Footprint**: First run downloads the selected checkpoint into `ComfyUI/models/RMBG/MultiMatte/` (`BF16` 1.57 GB default, `FP8` 0.84 GB low VRAM, `FP32` 3.13 GB).
- **Foreground Refinement Scope**: `refine_foreground` applies when `background` is set to `Alpha`.

---

## Inference & model settings (node defaults)

| Setting | Default | Options / Range |
|---------|---------|-----------------|
| Model | `MultiMatte-bf16 (1.57GB)` | `bf16` (1.57 GB) / `fp8` (0.84 GB) / `fp32` (3.13 GB) |
| Prompt | `""` *(empty = auto)* | Defaults internally to `"the main foreground subject"` |
| Precision (CUDA) | `float16` autocast | Automatic on CUDA devices |
| Refine Foreground | `True` | Sub-pixel blur-fusion foreground color estimation |
| Mask Blur / Offset | `0` / `0` | Blur `0–64`, Offset `-64–64` px |
